markets.rules_primary: If the signed one-month percent change in the seasonally adjusted Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers: All Items less Food and Energy for December 2022, as published by the Bureau of Labor Statistics, is greater than 0.7%, then the market resolves to Yes.

Please note that the value of the Underlying is the single-decimal value reported by the BLS.
